subject: The north side of Södra Långgatan between Larmgatan and Kaggensgatan: Södra Långgatan 9 with the courtyard house, Södra Långgatan 11, Södra Långgatan 13–15 (the long ochre house), Kaggensgatan 9 (the corner house) and Kaggensgatan 11 A–D (OSM ways 92204156, 92204161, 92204198, 92204187, 92204189). The Larmgatan corner building (92204170, 92204162) is left for a later pass.
author: Claude (Anthropic), night of 2026-09-23/24

known_deviations: Ochre house dormers: 0-5 px in view 165, 25-27 px low in the steep view 166 (the two panoramas disagree by about 0.5 m).
Corner house: the panoramas suggest its south front is 1-1.5 m narrower than OSM; its corner stays on OSM.

fixed_during_the_pass: 12,235 degenerate faces in 92204187: flat elliptical shop-window heads collapsed the global bevel clamp; now rectangular openings, spandrel prisms and a true segmental head
the rebuild saved untriangulated copies of the pass 26/28 meshes; they now get the export preparation without being exported, and match the pass 28 hashes
Södra Långgatan 11 windows 0.38 m west (joint misread behind a downpipe); corner house third window 0.65 m east
the ochre house shop floor was covered by a solid band; the wall is now split at the band
Södra Långgatan 11 gable: a triangular roof piece showed in front of the segmental gable; now a curved roof, and the gable 2.8 m wide
floating door treads on the corner house; now two stone steps
the first review shots after a reimport showed Nanite fallback meshes (no lunette, no awnings); shots are retaken two minutes after the import
